classification_rules.host-pointer: Typedefs or casts with pointer syntax, host-size aliases, HANDLE-like types, or deterministic pointer-shaped operands/names.
classification_rules.raw-layout: Serialize calls containing sizeof, host-dependent long typedefs, typedefs with no single fixed-width rule, and syntactically ambiguous cast operands.
classification_rules.reflected-host: Every CPP_PROPERTY occurrence because it computes a rebuilt host-member offset.
classification_rules.wire16: Typedefs and unambiguously numeric casts using fixed historical 16-bit aliases or short; declared alias names never classify their own underlying type.
classification_rules.wire32: Typedefs and unambiguously numeric casts using fixed historical 32-bit aliases, int, or float; declared alias names never classify their own underlying type.

detection_rules: Decode source as strict UTF-8 with strict Windows-1252 fallback; reject NULs and unterminated comments/literals.
Mask comments and literals without moving offsets; record every typedef through its balanced top-level semicolon.
Remove declared typedef names before classifying the underlying type; classify host-dependent long as raw-layout.
Record every balanced CPP_PROPERTY occurrence and every balanced Serialize call containing sizeof.
Record named and C-style casts whose destination is explicit pointer/host-size/historical integer syntax or a typedef classified that way.
Pointer-shaped syntax wins; an ambiguous single-identifier cast operand is raw-layout rather than omitted.

excluded_artifacts.rule: Only source-like suffixes under configured Src/Inc trees are scanned; binary/non-C++ artifacts and artifact directories are excluded.
